authorization.approved_resources: Daytona ephemeral sandboxes, up to 2x H100 80GB concurrently
authorization.user_approval_reference: Cowork session 2026-10-17: user supplied Daytona key, 'Keep trying to beat nanoGPT ASAP', selected '~$100 / up to 2xH100' and 'Branch + PR, no merge'.

data.dataset_versions: HF kjj0/fineweb10B-gpt2: fineweb_train_000001..000010 (1.0B tokens), fineweb_val_000000 (100M tokens)
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: FineWeb never previously used in this repository
data.split_boundaries: train = shards 1-10 concatenated; selection = val tokens [0, 50M); confirmation = val tokens [50M, 100M)
data.tokenizer_sha256: GPT-2 BPE (pretokenized upstream; vocab 50257 padded to 50304)

arms.hier: width 1344, 125,442,240 params, state reset every window (matches nanoGPT exposure)
arms.hier_stateful: same model; B contiguous lanes, state carried across adjacent windows, detached at window boundaries (TBPTT=context); evaluated streaming over contiguous lanes. Separately labeled: accesses history beyond the window, so it is a deployment-regime arm, not the primary comparison.

design.compute_accounting: measured train tokens/s on the same H100; analytic MACs/token
design.control_rationale: Primary comparison trains and evaluates both models at the same context, removing the historical 512-train/2K-eval extrapolation confound. Same tokenizer, data, sampler seed, token budget, optimizer recipe and LR grid.
design.learning_rate_trials_per_arm: 3: {3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3} at 100M tokens, seed 1, select by selection-half CE
design.matching_track: parameter-matched and token-matched; FLOPs and walltime reported, not matched
design.mechanism_equations: Unchanged HierarchicalDistributionStudent: fast GRUCell(3d->d) on [token, segment, document]; segment GRUCell on mean of fast over 32 tokens; document GRUCell every 8 segments; combine MLP 3d->2d->d; tied output. FastHierarchy runs each 32-token segment's fast recurrence as one cuDNN GRU call with the same weights (slow states are constant inside a segment).

evaluation.canonical_precision: bf16 autocast eval (FP32 CE accumulation); FP32 duplicate not performed in this run - disclosed limitation
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: single primary comparison; stateful arm and other contexts are secondary
evaluation.uncertainty_method: per-seed values, paired differences, mean and range

execution.canary_matrix: parity.py (FP32, 4 configs incl. saturated scale 3) and parity64.py (FP64)
execution.fidelity_tolerances: FP32: logits<=1e-4, loss<=1e-5, grad_rel<=1e-4, state<=1e-5; FP64: all<=1e-9

futility_rule: If after LR selection the best hierarchy selection CE is worse than best nanoGPT selection CE by >0.15 nats at 100M tokens, main 3-seed runs still execute (to document the gap) but no further budget is spent on scale-up of this arm.
hypothesis: The exact original 3-timescale GRU hierarchy (FastHierarchy execution, float64-identical to HierarchicalDistributionStudent) reaches lower held-out next-token CE than pinned upstream nanoGPT at ~125M params, matched training tokens, same data/tokenizer/optimizer recipe, trained and evaluated at the same context (1024).
primary_comparator: pinned upstream nanoGPT model.py sha256 7c01703240dbec5d554527dc666e35b3df8391d0b117fddc07afcf325a21d11c, 12L/12H/768, learned absolute positions, block_size = train = eval context
primary_metric: mean token cross-entropy (nats) on the confirmation half of fineweb_val_000000 (first 33,554,432 tokens of that half), non-overlapping reset windows at the training context
success_rule: hierarchy wins only if confirmation CE is lower on all 3 paired seeds AND mean paired improvement >= 0.02 nats. Otherwise report nanoGPT win / inconclusive as measured.

training.accessible_history: nanogpt/hier: 1024 window; hier_stateful: unbounded via carried state
training.document_reset_policy: no reset at EOT for any arm (EOT is a token, as in nanoGPT training)
training.optimizer_schedule: AdamW fused, betas (0.9,0.95), wd 0.1 on >=2D params, linear warmup 2% then cosine to 10% of peak, grad clip 1.0
training.precision: bf16 autocast, fp32 master weights; TF32 on
training.state_carry_and_detach: hier_stateful only, detach at each window
training.target_exposures_per_trial: LR trials 100M tokens; main runs 500M tokens
